issues.on_page: Documentation of Transfers: From Savings To Checking, Amount blank; lines 16/28 on p1 show 105,000.00
issues.issue: The transfer is a move between the district's own bank accounts (Savings to Checking), not between funds, and the Documentation of Transfers page leaves the amount blank. The amount comes from lines 16/28 on p1. Transfers in and out net to zero, so the roll-forward is unaffected.
